Notes for the handover. None of the three pages I read gave a day, time or price, so I left those fields out.

- **Town of Oakville:** 
Fall registration opened Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
 The class schedule sits behind the Town's booking login, and I could not read it. 
For a program that has already started, the registration system shows both the full price and a pro-rated price.
 That matters now, since fall is underway. The Town's page names the preschool levels but does not give an age range. A scraped copy of an older Town PDF lists 3-5 years, but I did not read that on the Town's own site, so I left it out of the pick.
- **YMCA of Oakville:** 
Swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions.
 
Registration is required each session, for members and non-members.
 The page mentions an evaluation for new participants before September 20, which has passed, so a new family would need to contact their aquatics department about placement. The lesson times were not on the page.
- **Goldfish Swim School:** 
Indoor lessons run on a consistent schedule year-round.
 The class listing is 
Junior (3-4 years)
. 
Every swimmer gets a swim skills assessment before formal lessons.
 The class times and prices were not on the pages I read.
